# Contract: docx

Third-party skill from [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills) (Apache-2.0, Anthropic), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Word documents). The method is upstream. Category: docs. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Create, read, or edit Word documents (.docx, .dotx).

## Use it for
- "write this as a Word document"
- "edit this .docx"

## Not for
- a markdown case study (work-to-explanation)
- a PDF (pdf)
- slides (pptx)

## Accepted inputs
The document to read or edit, or the content of one to create.

## Deliverables
A .docx file.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).
